description: IMDS credential requests are now retried with capped exponential backoff of 0.25, 0.5 and 1 seconds. Every failed request is retried except a token request rejected with 400 or 403 and a metadata request answered with 403 or 404. The new `IMDSConfig.max_attempts` defaults to 4 (3 retries) and can also be set with `AWS_METADATA_SERVICE_NUM_ATTEMPTS` or the `metadata_service_num_attempts` config setting. `IMDSConfig.retry_strategy`, which was never used, is deprecated: only its `max_attempts` is read, because IMDS is link-local and keeps its own short backoff. IMDS requests now time out after 1 second, except the connect timeout of an HTTP client you provide to the synchronous client, which is left as configured. Session tokens now expire after the TTL IMDS returns.
